newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Milford, Conn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Milford, Conn..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the City of Milford, Connecticut, at the Mayor's Office, City Hall, 110 River Street, Milford, Connecticut, subject to the provisions of the official Notice of Sale dated October 16, 1996.
Maturities: $370,000 on November 1, 1998, $550,000 on November 1 in each of the years 1999-2014, both
inclusive, and $555,000 on November 1 in each
Interest Paid: May 1 and November 1 in each year,

The Bonds shall NOT be designated by the City as qualified tax exempt obligations under the provisions of Section 265(b) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, for purposes of the deduction by financial institutions for interest expense allocable to the Bonds.

For copies of the official Notice of Sale, the Official Statement of the City of Milford, Connecticut, dated October 16, 1996, and bid form, please contact Ms. Elizabeth Schramek, Financial Advisor, Fleet Securities, Inc., 777 Main Street, Hartford, Connecticut 06115 (860-986-2776).
